basic_info.description: This stylish 8th-floor Junior 1-bedroom corner unit is designed for seamless work-life balance. Floor-to-ceiling northeast-facing windows flood the space with natural light, offering tranquil views of the landscaped courtyard and poolyour private escape from the city buzz.    The open layout features a chef's kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops, perfect for meal prep or casual entertaining. A modern bath with a tub/shower combo provides a spa-like retreat, while hardwood floors, in-unit laundry, a storage closet, and 1 car leased parking in the building's private residential garage (~$228/mo) add everyday ease.    Stay productive and recharge with 24/7 security, a fitness center, heated pool, spa, sauna, business center, clubhouse, and even a dog park.    Steps from the Ferry Building, Farmers Market, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and Embarcadero, with effortless access to Caltrain, Muni, BART, and highways.    Where innovation meets lifestyleyour next chapter starts here.
